title: Express a temporary current arrangement
instructions: Choose the form that matches the bounded current situation.

parts.prompt: For this week only, while the main counter is being repaired, the library ___ a temporary desk near the entrance.

choice_rationales.A: Simple past would place the temporary arrangement in a finished period.
choice_rationales.B: Is using presents the arrangement as temporary and in progress during this week.
choice_rationales.C: Usually uses describes a routine and contradicts the explicitly temporary one-week arrangement.
choice_rationales.D: Past perfect needs a later past reference point that the sentence does not provide.

parts.hint: For this week only and while the counter is being repaired bound a temporary situation around now.
parts.correct_explanation: Present continuous fits a temporary current arrangement limited to the repair period.
